subject: Meditech request: ephemeral inference log exception + SIG/CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Isha Patel <isha.patel@meditech.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Brightline Audit <auditor@brightline.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ evidence & tenant-specific retention alignment

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 scoping and our auditors have asked for the SIG/CAIQ bundle plus a clear statement about customer-scoped retention for inference logs in private deployments. A couple of clarifying questions from the audit team: 

- What is Redwood's default retention window for ephemeral inference/session logs for private deployments (VPC/on-prem) vs. Hosted?
- Can you support a tenant-level retention extension (Meditech tenant) from your default to 90 days for forensic purposes? If so, what compensating controls or contractual amendment do you require?
- Please include any artifacts you can share (CAIQ/SIG, SOC 2 evidence manifest, and an operations playbook that describes log handling, redaction, and deletion).

We need to present this to our auditor by Monday. For context: our tenant id is meditech-prod-07 and we run inference on a Redwood Private cluster managed by our security ops.

Appreciate a short response and any artifacts you can attach.

Thanks,
Isha Patel
Director, Information Security
Meditech Health
isha.patel@meditech.com

--
Attachments requested: SIG/CAIQ bundle, SOC2 evidence manifest, log playbook (stubs ok)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Isha Patel <isha.patel@meditech.com>
Cc: Brightline Audit <auditor@brightline.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence & tenant-specific retention alignment

Hi Isha — thanks for the clear ask and the tenant ID. Short answers up front: 

- Default ephemeral inference/session logs: Hosted API = 14 days; Private (standard config) = 30 days. These are the rolling TTLs for unindexed session/debug material.
- Tenant-level extension to 90 days: we can support this for Private deployments under a formal exception. Required items: signed amendment (SLA/retention addendum), SIEM-forwarding or customer-managed log-ship, encrypted-at-rest enforcement, and a short BLUF on justification.

I'm attaching the following artifacts to get you started:
- redwood_sig_caiaq_evidence_v2.pdf (CAIQ + SIG summary, redacted where needed)
- ephemeral_log_handling_playbook.pdf (ops runbook: ingestion, redaction, retention, deletion flows)

Next steps I suggest: please confirm the specific data classes that need the extension (all inference session payloads vs. metadata only), and whether Meditech wants us to retain raw session payloads or a sanitized derivative. Once you confirm, we (Marissa + Markus) can route an exception request to Legal/Privacy and generate the tenant exception template.

Timeline: if you confirm today, we can produce the amendment draft and required evidence pack by EOD Monday.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redwood_sig_caiaq_evidence_v2.pdf, ephemeral_log_handling_playbook.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, Isha Patel <isha.patel@meditech.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence & tenant-specific retention alignment

Kimberly / Markus / Isha — looping in the retention approval lane.

Quick internal note (for Kimberly and Markus):
- We've reviewed Meditech's justification (forensic investigation + regulatory archiving for a pilot cohort). Given Private deployment and their control plane separation, we can approve a 90-day retention exception for the meditech-prod-07 tenant conditional on the following being in place before the window is enabled: 
  1) Customer-signed retention addendum (template attached: tenant_exception_template.docx)
  2) Configured SIEM-forward (TLS 1.2+) to Meditech-managed collector OR agreement to ship archived snapshots to Redacted S3 with KMS keys owned by Meditech
  3) Confirmation that PII/PHI fields will be redacted at ingestion or represented as pseudonymized derivatives (we need a short example payload)
  4) A 30-day notice period for reversion/removal and a documented delete-cert process

Isha — if you can confirm those controls and upload a short sample payload (redacted) we will:
- Have Legal prepare the addendum draft (DocuSign link)
- Kick off a scoped runbook to implement SIEM forwarding and retention flags in the cluster

Attachment stub: tenant_exception_template.docx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

On Fri, Mar 30, 2028 at 10:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Isha — thanks for the clear ask and the tenant ID. Short answers up front: ...
From: Isha Patel <isha.patel@meditech.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence & tenant-specific retention alignment

Thanks Kimberly and Marissa — this is exactly what we needed. Confirming:

- Meditech requests the 90-day retention extension for meditech-prod-07 for forensic/incident analysis only.
- We will forward sanitized session payloads to our Splunk collector (details attached in a follow-up to your ops contact) and will use our own KMS keys for any archival snapshots.
- We will provide an example redacted payload by COB today.

Please go ahead and share the DocuSign/retention addendum and the draft amendment. Once Legal has the DocuSign we will sign promptly and notify our security ops to coordinate SIEM forwarding.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this helps our audit timeline.

Kind regards,
Isha Patel
Director, Information Security
Meditech Health
isha.patel@meditech.com

Follow-ups: Isha to upload sample payload; Redwood to circulate DocuSign link and schedule ops handoff
